tests: New, v25 and v26 wallets start the daily economy at 100 while lives and recorded prizes survive
x1 costs exactly 1, 5 or 10 coins, changes only while idle, and reload cannot replay a debit or life prize
Daily grant occurs once on a new local calendar day, accumulates remaining coins, and never refills by minutes or clock rollback
A month of absence grants one daily allowance, bounded at the safe balance ceiling
Insufficient coins cannot draw symbols or change lives and remaining coins offer the one-line option
Rewarded video is available at zero only and grants 100 once after earned=true; skipped/missing videos grant zero
The chosen paid lines are saved for Crystal bonus spins and cannot be increased mid-bonus
Forge relaunch spends the selected number of coins once and retains held columns
Only selected lines can win: a top-row match cannot pay on the one-line center setting
AUTO stops at the last affordable selected wager without negative coins or a third transaction
Page navigation cannot debit coins; a chest credits its coins and lives together
Invites are automatic and the game exposes no invitation switch or opt-in control
Malformed wallet and line fields restore bounded usable state
scope: Production wallet, line evaluation and automatic-invite UI with DOM/clock/rewarded adapters. No Android notification delivery or real ads are claimed.
